answer: Correlation penalties: when many accounts act in lockstep (same timing, same phrasing, the same umber-tinted fingerprint of style), the network treats them as one orchard grown from a single root and splits a single reward among them. A sybil farmer who spins up fifty identities earns no more than one, yet still pays fifty registration puzzles and bonds. The bridge from fake identities to extra income collapses, because duplication buys a shared slice, not a multiplied one.
